# P.K. Industries

> Manufacturer, exporter and supplier of steel melting shop consumables, established 2001
> in Adityapur, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, India. Four product lines: casting powder
> (continuous casting mould flux), nozzle filling compound, refractory castable, and
> ladle covering compound (Radex).

P.K. Industries supplies refractory consumables to steel producers across India, with the
shortest lead times to plants in Jharkhand, West Bengal, Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Bihar.
Grades are formulated to the customer's steel chemistry, casting route, casting speed and
mould or ladle dimensions rather than sold as fixed catalogue items. The company is owned
and managed by Mr. P.K. Gupta.

- Founded: 2001
- Location: C 10, Near Industrial Estate, Adityapur, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand 832109, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94313 42715
- Email: info@pkindustries.net
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST

## Products

- [Casting Powder](https://pkindustries.net/casting-powder.html): Continuous casting mould flux for billet, bloom and slab routes. Melts into a liquid slag film that lubricates the mould-shell gap, controls horizontal heat transfer, insulates the meniscus and absorbs inclusions. Basicity (CaO/SiO2) 0.8-1.3, total carbon 15-25%, softening range 950-1150 C, consumption 0.30-0.60 kg per tonne of steel.
- [Nozzle Filling Compound](https://pkindustries.net/nozzle-filling-compound.html): Chromite and silica based free-opening compound packed into the ladle nozzle before tapping. Resists sintering so the slide gate opens under gravity without oxygen lancing. Refractoriness above 1600 C, controlled particle size 0.10-1.50 mm, free opening target 90-98%.
- [Refractory Castable](https://pkindustries.net/castable.html): Monolithic refractory in 60% and 90% alumina grades for furnace linings, ladle linings, launders, burner blocks and tap-hole surrounds. Cold crushing strength above 40 MPa, service temperature 1450-1700 C, water addition 5-8% by weight.
- [Ladle Covering Compound (Radex)](https://pkindustries.net/ladle-covering-compound-radex.html): Low-density insulating powder spread over molten steel in the ladle to cut radiative heat loss and limit reoxidation. Bulk density 0.40-0.90 g/cc, expansion index 4x-8x, dosage 0.80-1.50 kg per tonne, typical heat loss reduction 25-40%.

## Terminology notes

Several products are known by more than one name in the industry, and these refer to the
same material:

- "Casting powder", "mould powder" and "mould flux" are the same product. "Casting powder"
  and "mould powder" are the usual shop-floor terms in India; "mould flux" is more common
  in academic and European literature.
- "Ladle covering compound", "Radex" and "ladle insulating powder" are used
  interchangeably in Indian steel plants. Radex is a trade name.
- "NFC" is the standard abbreviation for nozzle filling compound.
- "Free opening" refers to a ladle opening under gravity when the slide gate is actuated,
  without needing oxygen lancing to clear the nozzle.
